notes.title: Character Profile Reveal ③ Hakuto Kami
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, dear friends of fate! Hope you’re all doing well![/p][p]This time, in addition to the character profile, we’d also like to share a little “behind-the-scenes tidbit.”[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🤸A Curious Little Experiment: Character Figure Mockups[/b][/h3][p]Lately we’ve seen many people using nanobanana to make their own figures. Our mascot girl also joined in for fun—feeding the heroine’s illustration and chibi design of this issue into some high-tech magic, and creating figure-style mockups of in-game characters.[/p][p]They may, for now—or perhaps forever—never become reality, but we thought it would be fun to share them with you all anyway——[/p][p](The images below are purely for entertainment, so rest assured, your wallets are safe XD) [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/c564b52804390a53a6c49b8a3378ce623f5576d5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/fb672db54d689ee68a5cb39fee58421c6ac16666.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/58649fe6dddd831a3bd024e976efbabac9ec0f79.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/2ecd633b1875997d0729d6c19ed03f5d58e31dd5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/013439cc043243b425a222835ecd5da8fe26eedc.png"][/img][/p][p]If they really became figures, which one would you want the most? Feel free to leave a comment below~[/p][p][/p][p]Now then, back to the main topic, this time we bring you──[/p][h3][b]The true form of "ENSHIN" (the God of Bonds)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/efa8dcd0407785ac22118bdb248f446172675a45.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Text in the image[/p][quote][p]「O fated one, should you lend me your aid, I shall bestow upon you a most special reward~」[/p][p]「I am Enshin, the God of Bonds. As for my age… know that I am far, far older than you~」[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]👩🏻‍💼 Character File[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Name: Hakuto Kami[/p][/*][*][p]Apparent Age: 7[/p][/*][*][p]Traits: Eternal loli, hidden big breasts, bratty loli, (self-proclaimed) dignified, prank-loving[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]📖 Character Introduction[/b][/h3][p]Hakuto Kami is the deity enshrined at Moonlit Shrine, who governs warding off disasters, curing illnesses, and forming bonds. Her favorite offering is moon-viewing dumplings (tsukimi dango).[/p][p]Due to the nature of her origin as the “Hare of Inaba,” she sometimes feels the urge to play pranks. When excited, she has a habit of stomping her feet, and when she sees carrots, she shows a state of arousal. Since she cannot control herself in that state, she feels both embarrassed and troubled by it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/b874b4280ced068c1e0c384e8ea6a451eb8df650.png"][/img][/p][p]She can manifest massive weapons that contradict her petite appearance through ■■■■, strike with overwhelming force, and easily discern ■■■’s weaknesses. Acting as the “bad cop,” she steadily guides ■■■ toward growth.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/b1f6d67d881b80a6dc06275928830117169c5741.png"][/img][/p][code]What’s with the mysterious masked form? Is she still the same Hakuto Kami?[/code][p][/p][p]That’s all for today’s introduction. Until next time, dear friends of fate![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⭐ Wishlist Call[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146610/_/"][/dynamiclink]If you like this content, click the 【☆】on the top right to add the game to your wishlist! You’ll also receive the latest updates in your News Center~[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Free DEMO Trial[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304480/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]The DEMO version is now available! Feel free to download and try it for free. We also welcome your feedback through the review function~[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Character Profile Reveal ② Komame Nana
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p][b]Have you noticed that our store page looks different?[/b][/p][p]That's right! Starting this month, Steam has adopted a new standard for store details. We've updated our page with higher-resolution character images and a more detailed introduction of game features, all presented with dynamic animations. Go check it out now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146610/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]A sickly, shy little sister who blurts out Minnan phrases when nervous![/b][/h3][p]This news update also brings the second round of character introductions—featuring top-secret details of the other heroine, “Azuki Nana.”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/113330b1594ddd8f04bc0a7f9aa5a36bc637ba42.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Text in the image[/p][quote][p]"Tōryanse, Tōryanse—can you hear my voice?"[/p][p]"Thank you for your concern… um, I have a request…"[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3][b]👩🏻‍💼 Character Profile[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Name: Komame Nana[/p][/*][*][p]Apparent Age: 14[/p][/*][*][p]Traits: Little sister type, social anxiety, pure, fast learner, [b]sometimes speaks Minnan dialect[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]📖 Character Introduction[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/1ce299d294fb2abba9c4a9f0f964cf929815cf66.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s said that she was influenced by ■■■■ at birth, granting her a pair of cat ears and a tail. Though she can conceal them, doing so consumes significant spiritual energy, so she often wears a scarf handmade by ■■■■ to avoid unwanted attention.[/p][p][/p][p]Born into a poor family, she learned how to be polite and helpful from a young age, excelling at housework and sewing. Frail and often ill, she sometimes makes small mistakes, but even through tears, she always tries to finish her tasks. Due to ■■■■■■, she firmly believes in the gods as beings capable of saving her, dreaming of one day serving at Inazuki Shrine as a ■■■ and fulfilling her wish to become the ■■■■’s bride.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/4ed25834355a4858b25c4d6a2c5b5add826cd3e3.png"][/img][/p][p]At times, she unintentionally shows a maturity beyond her years, though her thoughts remain innocent and childlike. After growing close to Hanamizuki, she occasionally reveals a playful, teasing side that’s quite adorable. Due to the influence of ■■ bloodline ■■, she sometimes blurts out a few words in Minnan dialect without realizing it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⭐ Add to Wishlist[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146610/_/"][/dynamiclink]If you like this update, click the 【☆】 in the top right to add the game to your wishlist and receive the latest updates in the News Hub![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 DEMO Free Trial[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304480/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]The DEMO is now available! Download it for free and give it a try. We’d love to hear your feedback through the review feature![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Character Profile ① Amamiya Hanamizuki
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]It’s been a while—let’s start with some good news![/p][p]Our game development is going smoothly, and the creation of the main theme content has entered the final stage. The full release will truly be meeting everyone this year![/p][p][/p][p]Taking this opportunity, I’d like to share a few little secrets that I haven’t mentioned before—[/p][p]Before summer ends, I will introduce the four main heroines of “Spiritual Bond” one by one, revealing some first-time information not found in the basic store page details. This includes character profile cards, profiles, hidden settings related to the story, as well as adorable standing illustration outfits/action variations, expressions, and chibi visual designs, all of which you can preview in upcoming announcements.[/p][p][/p][p]First up, Heroine No. 1: Amamiya Hanamizuki[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/380521acc887f2c287d0b89c390e48d8f7f473fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The lines in the image translate to:[/p][quote][p]"I am the fox shrine maiden of Sakurada Village... For what purpose did I come to Inazuki Village?"
"If it were you, would you help me find all the answers to this?"[/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/253f0fe78ec74d7141938a2eaec3ce56850b98a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👩🏻‍💼 Character Profile[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Name: Amamiya Hanamizuki[/p][/*][*][p]Apparent Age: 17[/p][/*][*][p]Traits: Gentle, sisterly, rational, occasionally clumsy, loves cute things[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]📖 Character Introduction[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/f1d65a9db22f3e33051844f146e0dd26dca99179.png"][/img][/p][p]Amamiya Hanamizuki was born into a family of shrine maidens who have, since ancient times, made pacts with the fox god. She also hails from a prestigious family that governs Sakurada Village. Her mother had been by her side since she was young, yet in the end was taken by the hands of the妖怪 she trusted most—■■. This event completely shattered her trust in妖怪. On the eve of■■■■■■■■, she resolutely left her hometown and set out on a journey toward■■■■.[/p][p][/p][p]Later, she strayed into Inazuki Village, but after violating the village’s barrier, she suffered backlash and impact, resulting in the loss of her memory. In her fox form, she is exceptionally powerful in combat, especially when blending the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox into her swordsmanship, unleashing overwhelming force. As her number of tails increases, so does her strength—but so too does the strain on her body.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45146940/8133412f48d4fc585e8bc3b602e2677136b5fb65.png"][/img][/p][p]Though born into privilege, Hanamizuki is somewhat lacking in everyday common sense, and sometimes shows a clumsy side. As a shrine maiden and elder sister, she is dependable and kind, but when faced with cute things, she can’t help but get “dizzy with infatuation.” In that serious expression lies a charm that makes people both worry for her and want to protect her.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⭐ Wishlist Recruitment[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146610/_/"][/dynamiclink]If you enjoyed this content, click the 【☆】 in the upper right corner to add the game to your wishlist, so you can receive the latest updates in the News Hub![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Free DEMO Trial[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3304480/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]The game’s DEMO has already been released! If you’re interested, feel free to download it for free and give it a try. We welcome your feedback via the review feature![/p]
